summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K to disclose its total voting rights and capital as of 30 July 2026, pursuant to UK Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rule 5.6.1. The filing states that issued share capital is 17,183,563,842 ordinary shares of US$0.50 each, with no shares in treasury, resulting in the same number of total voting rights. Shareholders may use this figure as the denominator to determine notification obligations under UK and Hong Kong rules. This routine disclosure does not relate to any special situation such as an acquisition, restructuring, or management change.
